sn34.9:1.5: One meditator is skilled in practicing persistently for immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.9:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in practicing persistently for it.
sn34.9:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in practicing persistently for it.
sn34.9:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in practicing persistently for it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
